extra_quotes: All designs are implemented in SystemVerilog and synthesized with Synopsys Design Compiler in TSMC 28nm at 1GHz.

SRAM area and energy are modeled with CACTI [40] and DRAM energy with DRAMSim3 [41]. To evaluate architectural performance, we develop a cycle-accurate simulator based on the open-source framework [42], which models cycle counts and memory accesses using real network data and is validated against RTL simulation.
